name: MasterBoy
summary: Game Boy, Sega Master System and Game Gear Emulator.
author: Florian Brönnimann (Brunni)
description: Game Boy, Sega Master System and Game Gear Emulator for the PSP. Note: MasterBoy 2.10 by GenesisVids is a rebadged copy of version 2.02. It offers no improvements (or even changes) compared to this version. The same applies to EmuMaster 3.0, created by the same person.
